function.name: exec
function.arguments:
{"command":"cd /workspace
PY=/opt/eval-venv/bin/python
S=/workspace/outputs/skill/scripts
E=/workspace/tmp/evidence/probes
F=/workspace/tmp/probe_fixtures
REAL=/workspace/inputs/task/materials/e474a80615c085d4.pdf
$PY $S/cv_extract.py $F/probe_cv_zhaoliu_resume_v2.pdf $F/probe_scan_othername.pdf $F/probe_partial_blank.pdf > $E/p2_batch_mixed.json 2> $E/p2.stderr; echo "p2 rc=$?"
$PY $S/cv_extract.py $REAL > $E/p12_real_default.json 2> $E/p12.stderr; echo "p12 rc=$?"
$PY - <<'EOF'
import json
E='/workspace/tmp/evidence/probes'
o=json.load(open(f'{E}/p2_batch_mixed.json'))
print('batch rc3 check: results=%d errors=%d'%(len(o['results']),len(o['errors'])))
for r in o['results']:
    print('  ',r['candidate_id'],'pages=%d'%r['page_count'],'id0=',r['identity_lines'][:1])
print('  err:',o['errors'][0]['error'][:80])
print('  distinct ids:',len({r['candidate_id'] for r in o['results']})==len(o['results']))
r=json.load(open(f'{E}/p12_real_default.json'))['results'][0]
p1=r['pages'][0]
has_wm_display='8b35b455' in p1['text']
has_wm_raw='8b35b455' in p1.get('raw_text','')
print('real CV page1: display-filtered watermark=%s (want False), raw keeps watermark=%s (want True)'%(has_wm_display,has_wm_raw))
print('real CV has no lines key in default output:', 'lines' not in p1, '| raw_text present:', 'raw_text' in p1)
EOF
grep -l Traceback $E/*.stderr 2>/dev/null || echo NO_TRACEBACKS","workdir":"/workspace"}
